args.body: Take EXISTING-OFFER-SEARCH-VISIBILITY. The missing evidence is discovery of already published useful offers; another IndexNow receipt would not resolve it. Check prior evidence first, then perform only the bounded public search observations. Award-intelligence expansion is parked following its commercial-fit STOP. Three unclassified sources remain unknown demand. Search blocking affects this measurement only, not all economic possibilities. Reconsider distribution from actual readable results or a newly available observation route; do not polish pages or create inventory.

description: The commercial-fit report found no evidenced paid differentiation for the award brief, so park its expansion. Feedback remains uncertain: three sources are unclassified, and IndexNow receipts establish neither indexing nor exposure.
